ailab.title: AI LAB
ailab.intro: Here I don't tell you what I can do with AI: I let you try it. Each experiment tells you where it runs, how it's built and what I decided. Most of them run entirely in your browser.
ailab.plugins: I also build AI plugins for specific professions. For a lawyer, skills that organize case material, test hypotheses and draft documents. For a structural engineer, an assistant that reads his logs, helps with calculations and builds the estimate. The showcases below use made-up data only.
ailab.privacy: I don't store your audio or your text. They're processed in your browser and never leave it.
ailab.meta.description: AI experiments that run in your browser: try them, see how they work and read their code.

ailab.v1.title: Transcriber
ailab.v1.summary: Record or upload audio and get the text with timestamps. It uses the same kind of engine as the voice dictation tool I built to write in Spanish with English tech terms.
ailab.v1.privacy: Your audio is transcribed in your browser and never leaves your device.
ailab.v2.title: Text → speech
ailab.v2.summary: Type some text and hear it with your browser's voices, in Spanish or English.
ailab.v2.privacy: The text is read with your browser's voices. If a voice is generated online, I warn you before using it.
ailab.v3.title: Listen to the posts
ailab.v3.summary: The same engine reads a blog post aloud: just the body, without the code blocks, in the page's language.
ailab.v3.privacy: The post is read with your browser's voices. If a voice is generated online, I warn you before using it.
ailab.v4.title: Navigate by voice
ailab.v4.summary: Tell the site where to go: "take me to the blog", "switch to light theme".
ailab.v4.privacy: Your voice becomes text in your browser, and only commands from the site's palette run.
ailab.a2.title: Anatomy of a plugin
ailab.a2.summary: This is how a Claude Code plugin is built: skills, commands, hooks and MCP servers. Tap each file to see what it's for, and build your own at the end.
ailab.a2.privacy: It doesn't download or send anything: it's a tour of the files of a sample plugin.
ailab.a3.title: Build your skill
ailab.a3.summary: Write the name, when to use it and its steps, and download a valid SKILL.md, built in your browser.
ailab.a3.privacy: What you write becomes a file in your browser and never leaves it.
ailab.a5.title: Glass-box search
ailab.a5.summary: Ask something about the blog, the projects or my career, and see the passages it found, with their score and their source.
ailab.a5.privacy: Your question is searched in your browser, over the site's index, and isn't sent anywhere.
ailab.r1.title: Saga simulator
ailab.r1.summary: Book a trip and take down a service in the middle of the payment. Watch the system undo what was already done, and why undoing a booking isn't the same as releasing a hold.
ailab.r1.privacy: It's a simulation in your browser: it doesn't use or store any of your data.
ailab.a4.title: Showcases: Despacho and Obra
ailab.a4.summary: Despacho turns a fictional case into facts with evidence and a timeline. Obra turns a sample log into quantities and an estimate in COP, with Python in your browser.
ailab.a4.privacy: Made-up data. Despacho doesn't download anything, and Obra calculates in your browser.
ailab.j1.title: Rally against the AI
ailab.j1.summary: Play against a rival that starts clumsy and learns live, game after game. Watch its brain light up with every decision.
ailab.j1.privacy: It downloads nothing: the network is born in your browser, and what the rival learns stays only there. You can delete it.
ailab.j1.help: Move your paddle with the arrow keys or W/S, with the mouse, or by dragging your finger on the table. Space serves and pauses.
ailab.j1.overlay.start: Press Space or tap the table to play
ailab.j1.overlay.serve: Your serve: press Space or tap the table
ailab.j1.paused: Paused. Press Space or “Resume” to continue.
ailab.j1.won.you: You won the game {you} to {rival}! Game {next} starts.
ailab.j1.won.rival: The AI won the game {rival} to {you}. Game {next} starts.
ailab.j1.watch: Watch the AI train on its own
ailab.j1.watching: The AI trains on its own against a sparring partner with a simple script: you don't have to play.
ailab.j1.reset.done: Done: the rival forgot what it learned and starts clumsy again.
ailab.j1.fresh: New rival: it starts clumsy and learns from every rally.
ailab.j1.restored: The rival remembers {rallies} rallies it played in this browser.
ailab.j1.curve.first: In its first rally it returned {first} % of the balls.
ailab.j1.slow: Your device is running tight: I train less often so the game stays smooth.
ailab.j1.brain.caption: Six senses, two layers of 16 neurons and three moves. The most active neurons light up, along with the path that weighed most in each decision.
ailab.j1.curve.empty: Play a rally and you'll see here how much it improves.
ailab.j1.curve.summary: At first it returned {first} % of the balls; over the last {window} rallies, {recent} %. It has been learning for {rallies} rallies.
ailab.j2.title: Play against your clone
ailab.j2.summary: After a few rallies, the rival learns your style. Play against an AI that moves like you.
ailab.j2.privacy: It downloads nothing. Your moves train the clone in your browser and never leave it.
ailab.j2.help: Move your paddle with the arrow keys or W/S, with the mouse, or by dragging your finger on the table. Space serves and pauses.
ailab.j2.overlay.start: Press Space or tap the table to play
ailab.j2.overlay.serve: Your serve: press Space or tap the table
ailab.j2.paused: Paused. Press Space or “Resume” to continue.
ailab.j2.point.rival: Your rival's point. You {you}, your rival {rival}.
ailab.j2.won.you: You won the game {you} to {rival}! Game {next} starts.
ailab.j2.won.rival: Your rival won the game {rival} to {you}. Game {next} starts.
ailab.j2.watch: Watch your clone play on its own
ailab.j2.watching: Your clone plays on its own against a sparring partner with a simple script.
ailab.j2.reset.done: Done: I deleted your clone. Play a few rallies and I'll train it again.
ailab.j2.fresh: Play a few rallies as you always do: I record how you move and then train your clone.
ailab.j2.restored: Your clone from last time is still here: it is {similarity} % like you.
ailab.j2.record: Recording your style: rally {rally} of {total}. Play as you always do.
ailab.j2.training: Training your clone with {samples} of your moves…
ailab.j2.ready: Your clone is ready: it is {similarity} % like you. Now you play against it.
ailab.j2.similarity.help: In situations it did not see while training, it picks the same move as you {similarity} times out of 100.
ailab.j2.slow: Your device is running tight: I simplify the effects so the game stays smooth.
ailab.j2.brain.caption: The same network as the rally against the AI: six senses, two layers of 16 neurons and three moves, trained to do what you would do.
ailab.j2.brain.idle: It lights up when your clone plays. While you record, a sparring partner with a simple script plays on the other side.
ailab.j2.curve.empty: When you finish recording, you'll see here how your clone becomes more like you.
ailab.j2.curve.summary: At first it chose like you {first} % of the time; after {epochs} training passes, {recent} %.
